feeds.title: All Those Before Blog
feeds.description: A genealogy and family history blog, covering biographies of ancestors, research tips (and pitfalls!) along with the joys of discovering more about one's past. Strictly a hobby, not a business.

feeds.title: PastToPresentGenealogy
feeds.description: Specialising in West Yorkshire ancestry, including Irish immigration, and Great War ancestors. AGRA Associate.

feeds.title: Charnwood Genealogy
feeds.description: Having studied genealogy and obtained a Post Graduate Certificate in Genealogy through the University of Strathclyde in Glasgow, I have helped several people discover their family history and developed their family trees.

feeds.title: The Parchment Rustler
feeds.description: The Parchment Rustler is the genealogy blog of Dr. Sophie Kay. She is a professional researcher working in genealogy and genetics. Sophie is an experienced educator, with a particular interest in teaching research skills and collaborative, open working practices. Follow the blog to get more updates.

feeds.title: The GENES Blog | British GENES (Genealogy News and Events)
feeds.description: A daily news blog about genealogy, family history and personal heritage. The top stories and events concerning British Isles and diaspora ancestral research from Irish born Scottish based blogger and family historian Chris Paton.

feeds.title: Irish Genealogy
feeds.description: It's a free online guide to Irish family history research, and it's designed to help you to find your heritage.

feeds.title: Lifelines Research Blog
feeds.description: This is the website for Lifelines Research, a genealogical research business run by Dave Annal

feeds.title: Bespoke Genealogy
feeds.description: Bespoke Genealogy is about British and Irish genealogy history and travel. We help people find their roots and plan their vacations in the United Kingdom and Ireland. There are tips and tricks, advice and resources.

feeds.title: Mikey Dawson
feeds.description: Family history blogger and genealogist in Leeds, UK I am passionate about family history and have been researching my family for more than 20 years. I have particular interests in the areas around Keighley, Cowling, Skipton and the Yorkshire Dales. Also Clitheroe, Blackburn and Burnley in Lancashire and Kendal in Cumbria.

feeds.title: Emma Jolly Blog
feeds.description: Notes inspired by my work as a genealogist in twenty-first century London.

feeds.title: Genealogical Ponderings Blog
feeds.description: Genealogist providing family history research and family trees in Cambridgeshire, Suffolk, and Essex.
